control_60.definition: same UTC weekday+HH:MM, outside +/-240m of any eligible T0, median USD pips across 6 pairs, |median|; all matches kept

notes: published_change = headline_mom - previous_as_reported only when both are 1-month SA first prints

spread.note: M5 OHLC cannot reconstruct tick-level max spread inside the release candle. Pair pip sizes differ (JPY 0.01).
